verdict.rationale: Fathom is a meeting transcription and summary product, so multilingual support is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions supported languages, non-English transcription, or handling language switching mid-meeting. The general transcription and summary claims (unlimited transcriptions, instant AI summaries) say nothing about language coverage.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run meetings in languages other than English — transcription and summaries support many languages and handle language switching
